{{Top}}
[[File:EnterpriseCrewOnJomark-DFR3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A groundcar on [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]]]]
A '''groundcar''' was any type of [[wheel]]ed vehicle. '''Cars''', as they were often called, were similar to [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], but differing in that they moved by the rotation of wheels instead of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. This method was much older and slower, and prone to mechanical failure, but was useful as a cheap substitute to a speeder on a paved road.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

Most groundcars were civilian urban transit models, but some were military vehicles like the [[armored groundcar]], and even massive tanks like the [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]].

The term was also colloquially applied to some tracked ground vehicles, such as [[personnel carrier]]s.<ref name="SW:EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
